title: The deploy.sh Deploy Script
description: A deploy script that holds all the deploy logic, fails fast, reads the token from the environment, and never prints it.

steps.description: This is `deploy.sh`, the entire deploy logic. The shebang names bash, and `set -euo pipefail` makes the script fail fast: stop on any error, error on an unset variable, and catch errors mid-pipe.
The token arrives in the environment, never as a command-line argument and never hardcoded. The `: "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?...}"` line fails loudly if the token is missing.
`WORKER_NAME` comes from a plain variable, and the `echo` prints only the name, never the token.
`npx wrangler deploy --name "${WORKER_NAME}" </dev/null` is non-interactive. The `</dev/null` guarantees no step can block waiting for input in CI.
The comment states the point: the workflow only decides when to run this, and the script runs identically on your laptop and in CI, which makes it testable.
